name: Page (Antelope Canyon)
tagline: Slot canyons and the Horseshoe Bend
summary: Page is a small desert town beside Lake Powell surrounded by some of the Southwest's most photographed places. Walk through the glowing light beams of Antelope Canyon with a Navajo guide, peer down at the Colorado River curling round Horseshoe Bend, and take a boat or kayak into Lake Powell's red-rock canyons.
seasonNote: Light beams in Upper Antelope are best from April to September around midday; summer is very hot.
arrival: About 4.5 hours from Las Vegas, 2.5 hours from the Grand Canyon South Rim.
gettingAround: A car; canyons require Navajo-guided tours.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants. Sales tax is added at the till.
foodTip: Navajo tacos, Southwestern BBQ and Mexican food.
